title: Respect staff termination/end date in new activity, leave and admin OT selection forms; preserve historic records
changes: New activity/training participants: hide staff whose employment ended before the activity date; adjust immediately when date changes.
Admin leave and OT confirm-duty/extra-OT selection: filter by employment date and Active flag; do not remove saved historic OT rows.
Group activity OT participant list: remove unavailable staff from current selections and prevent submission of expired participants.
Add warning on Users page if employment end date has passed while Active remains true.
Historical exports, existing activities/leave records, roster archives and Supabase data are untouched.
notes: When marking a staff member as departed, set employment_end_date and Active=false (and roster disabled if appropriate), then Save. App update filters new input forms even if Active accidentally stays true.
